name: The Freshman: Snowed In
source:
After heavy snowfall prevents access in and out of the university, will you and your friends find a way to make the most of your time together or will it end in disaster?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Freshman:_Snowed_In]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
大雪阻碍大学进出后，你和你的朋友会找到一种方法来充分利用你们在一起的时间，还是会以灾难告终？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Freshman:_Snowed_In]Choices Wikia[/url]]
